categories.name: Office Casuals
categories.description: Shirts, polos and knitwear cut for a working day that runs long.
categories.bannerLine: Smart enough for the boardroom, soft enough for the drive home.
categories.imageAlt: Man in a charcoal blazer over an open collar shirt
categories.blurb: Our office casuals are built around breathable cottons and lightweight wools. They hold a crease through a nine-hour day and still look right at a family dinner.

categories.name: Kurta Pajama
categories.description: Occasion sets in cotton, linen and silk blends. Made to be worn often.
categories.bannerLine: For the wedding season, the festivals and every quiet evening in between.
categories.imageAlt: Man wearing an off-white kurta pajama set
categories.blurb: Our kurta pajamas are finished by hand in our Erise workshop. Every set is pressed, checked and ready to wear, so nothing arrives needing work.

products.name: Charcoal Wool-Blend Blazer
products.fabricNote: 70% wool, 30% polyester. Half-canvas construction with a soft shoulder.
products.description: A single-breasted blazer with a gentle shoulder and a clean, slightly shorter hem. It sits well over both a formal shirt and a plain tee.
products.care: Dry clean only. Steam lightly between wears and store on a broad wooden hanger.

images.alt: Charcoal wool-blend blazer worn open over a white shirt, front view
Charcoal wool-blend blazer shown from the side, sleeve and lapel detail
Charcoal wool-blend blazer laid flat, showing the internal half-canvas chest

products.name: Oxford Cotton Shirt
products.fabricNote: 100% long-staple cotton, 140 gsm. Garment washed for softness.
products.description: The everyday shirt. Enough structure for the office, soft enough that you forget you have it on.
details: Split back yoke with centre pleat
products.care: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle. Hang dry and iron damp for the sharpest finish.

images.alt: White oxford cotton shirt worn with sleeves buttoned at the wrist
Oxford cotton shirt collar and placket shown close up
Oxford cotton shirt folded, showing the garment-washed texture

products.name: Slim Washed Chinos
products.fabricNote: 98% cotton, 2% elastane. 240 gsm with a light stone wash.
products.description: A straight-through slim chino with just enough give to sit through a full day. Holds its shape without feeling stiff.
details: Mid rise, slim through the thigh
Two front pockets, two welt back pockets
products.care: Machine wash cold, inside out. Tumble dry low. Warm iron on the reverse.

images.alt: Sand slim washed chinos worn with an untucked shirt
Slim chinos shown from the side to show the taper
Slim chinos folded showing the cotton twill weave

products.name: Linen Half-Sleeve Shirt
products.fabricNote: 100% European flax linen, 165 gsm. Stone washed.
products.description: Our best-selling piece through every Ahmedabad summer. Linen moves with you and pulls heat away as you go.
products.care: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle. Do not bleach. Iron while damp.

images.alt: Off-white linen half-sleeve shirt worn untucked

products.name: Textured Knit Polo
products.fabricNote: 60% cotton, 40% modal. Fine-gauge textured knit.
products.description: A polo with a real collar that holds its shape, and a knit body that stays smooth after a day of wear.
products.care: Machine wash cold, inside out. Reshape while damp and dry flat.

images.alt: Ecru textured knit polo worn with chinos
Textured knit polo collar and placket close up
Textured knit polo showing the fine knit texture

products.name: Straight Cut Indigo Denim
products.fabricNote: 100% cotton, 13.5 oz. Sanforised, will soften with wear.
products.description: A straight leg in honest, heavy denim. Buy it slightly long and let it break once over the shoe.
products.care: Wash sparingly, inside out, cold. Line dry. Expect the indigo to settle into your wear pattern.

images.alt: Raw indigo straight cut denim worn full length
Indigo denim showing the rivet and pocket detail
Indigo denim folded showing the chain-stitched hem

products.name: Herringbone Waistcoat
products.fabricNote: 80% wool, 20% nylon herringbone. 260 gsm.
products.description: A single most useful thing in the collection. Wear it with denim on Friday or under a blazer on Monday.
products.care: Dry clean. Steam rather than press to keep the herringbone depth.

images.alt: Grey herringbone waistcoat worn over a white shirt
Herringbone waistcoat showing the welt pocket detail
Herringbone waistcoat flat, showing the weave

products.name: Poplin Formal Shirt
products.fabricNote: 100% extra-long staple cotton, 120 gsm. Two-ply yarn.
products.description: Crisp, cool and cut close without being tight. The shirt we keep a spare of at the counter.
products.care: Machine wash 40°C. Iron damp on the reverse for a crisp finish.

images.alt: Crisp white poplin formal shirt worn tucked

products.name: Tapered Linen Trouser
products.fabricNote: 55% linen, 45% cotton. 200 gsm with a dry handle.
products.description: Tailored but easy. The texture reads relaxed while the line stays clean.
details: Mid rise, tapered from the knee
Slant front pockets, welt back pocket
products.care: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle. Hang dry. Iron on the reverse.

images.alt: Flax tapered linen trouser worn with a tucked shirt

products.name: Cable Knit Sweater
products.fabricNote: 100% extra-fine merino wool, 12 gauge. Fully fashioned.
products.description: A proper cable knit in fine merino. Warm without bulk, and it layers cleanly under the blazer.
details: Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and hem
products.care: Hand wash cold or dry clean. Dry flat away from direct heat.

products.name: Cotton Silk Kurta Pajama
products.fabricNote: 70% cotton, 30% silk. Handloom woven with a soft sheen.
products.description: Our signature set. A kurta with quiet drape over a drawstring pajama, finished with tone-on-tone plackets.
details: Matching drawstring pajama with two pockets
products.care: Hand wash separately in cold water for the first wash. Dry in shade, iron on low.

products.name: Chikankari Kurta
products.fabricNote: 100% cotton mul, hand-embroidered with cotton thread.
products.description: Hand-embroidered in Lucknow on a fine cotton base. Every piece takes about nine days on the frame.
details: Roughly nine days of hand work per kurta
products.care: Hand wash cold. Dry flat in shade. Iron on the reverse over a cloth.

products.name: Linen Kurta Set
products.fabricNote: 100% washed linen, 170 gsm. Gets softer with every wash.
products.description: The everyday kurta. Cool, quiet and genuinely comfortable, with a straight pajama to match.
products.care: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle. Do not bleach. Iron while damp.

products.name: Rayon Straight Kurta
products.fabricNote: 100% viscose. Fluid fall with a dry, matte finish.
products.description: A clean straight kurta that falls well without clinging. The one our customers reorder most.
products.care: Hand wash cold. Do not wring. Dry flat in shade. Cool iron.

products.name: Bandhgala Kurta Set
products.fabricNote: Silk-cotton blend, 220 gsm with a soft lustre.
products.description: A closed-neck bandhgala cut for evening functions. Structured through the shoulder, comfortable everywhere else.
products.care: Dry clean recommended. Steam lightly between wears.

products.name: Hand Block Print Kurta
products.fabricNote: 100% cotton, hand block printed with natural vegetable dyes.
products.description: Printed by hand, so no two are identical. A relaxed kurta with a full-width block motif.

Natural vegetable dye colour variation is expected

products.name: Pathani Kurta Set
products.fabricNote: 100% combed cotton, 180 gsm. Slightly sheer, deliberately.
products.description: A long-sleeve Pathani cut for the wedding itself. Light enough for an afternoon function in May.

products.description: Our most formal piece. A silk-blend kurta with tonal embroidery, cut for movement through a long evening.

Lined yoke for a clean finish

products.description: Slightly uneven, completely soft. A kurta that looks effortless because it is.

products.description: Our lightest set. Made for Ahmedabad evenings when even linen feels heavy.
products.care: Hand wash cold. Do not wring. Dry flat in shade.
